mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as "main"
  participant App as "app_start"
  participant Platform as "IHM16M1 platform"
  participant Driver as "x_nucleo_ihm16m1"
  participant UART as "LPUART1"
  participant Commands as "uart_command"
  participant Motor as "motor_control"
  participant Watchdog as "IWDG"
  participant PWM as "TIM1 PWM"

  Boot->>App: call app_start
  App->>Platform: ihm16m1_platform_start
  Platform->>PWM: HAL_TIM_PWM_Start on channels 1 to 3
  Platform->>Platform: configure PA8 PA9 PA10 PA11 PC9 and ADC1
  App->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_init
  Driver->>Platform: disable PWM and set standby
  Platform->>PWM: set all compares to zero
  App->>Motor: motor_control_init
  Motor->>Driver: pwm_enable false
  App->>UART: uart_platform_start
  UART-->>App: start interrupt line reception
  App->>Watchdog: watchdog_platform_start
  loop every 1 ms
    App->>Commands: uart_command_process
    alt complete command line available
      Commands->>UART: uart_platform_read_line
      Commands->>Motor: start stop speed or direction request
      alt STATUS command
        Commands->>Motor: motor_control_get_status
        Commands->>UART: uart_platform_write
        UART-->>Commands: HAL_UART_Transmit
      end
    else no complete line
      Commands-->>App: return without command
    end
    App->>Motor: motor_control_process with 1 ms
    Motor->>Driver: x_nucleo_ihm16m1_drive_motor
    Driver->>Platform: pwm_set for U V and W
    Platform->>PWM: update TIM1 compare values
    App->>Watchdog: watchdog_platform_kick
    App->>Platform: ihm16m1_platform_delay for 1 ms
  end
title: Sequence Diagram
